name: Explosive Meteor
body:
School evocation [earth]; Level: sorcerer/wizard 3

Components: V,S,M (A tiny piece of volcanic or meteoric rock)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Area: 15 ft. radius spread

Duration: Instantaneous

Saving Throw: Reflex half; Spell Resistance: yes

This spell is similar to a fireball, but instead of a ball of fire it is a tiny meteor that detonates, showering the area with chunks of rock that inflict 1d6 bludgeoning damage per level (max 8d6). The meteor has no heat and will not set fire to combustibles or melt metals as a fireball would.
